title: plugins: Don't unload plugins when using LSan/ASan
description:
If plugins are unloaded before the program ends, then LeakSanitizer
won't be able to resolve symbols and will report (<unknown module>)
instead of a symbol name, filename, and location. This makes it
considerably less useful:
https://github.com/google/sanitizers/issues/89

It's possible to do some tricks with dlopen, but just mark plugins as
resident via GModule so that they doesn't get closed.

Before:
```shell
=================================================================
==2349158==ERROR: LeakSanitizer: detected memory leaks

Direct leak of 82 byte(s) in 8 object(s) allocated from:
    #0 0x5579689a4858 in malloc (/home/johnthacker/wireshark-qt6-clang-build/run/tshark+0xa9858) (BuildId: b44305b39db48af53d3b7f3d781bf636b13fabbf)
    #1 0x7feeb58f1fe9 in g_malloc (/lib64/libglib-2.0.so.0+0x46fe9) (BuildId: 2acd4dfbc176f0dd02c08005d3214bc81469bc57)
    #2 0x7feeb590be39 in g_strdup (/lib64/libglib-2.0.so.0+0x60e39) (BuildId: 2acd4dfbc176f0dd02c08005d3214bc81469bc57)
    #3 0x7beea0fe6109  (<unknown module>)
    #4 0x7beea0ff0432  (<unknown module>)
    #5 0x7beea0fba847  (<unknown module>)
    #6 0x7beea0fb1c78  (<unknown module>)
```

After:
```shell
=================================================================
==2349624==ERROR: LeakSanitizer: detected memory leaks

Direct leak of 82 byte(s) in 8 object(s) allocated from:
    #0 0x55e7a9bdc858 in malloc (/home/johnthacker/wireshark-qt6-clang-build/run/tshark+0xa9858) (BuildId: b44305b39db48af53d3b7f3d781bf636b13fabbf)
    #1 0x7ff5245bbfe9 in g_malloc (/lib64/libglib-2.0.so.0+0x46fe9) (BuildId: 2acd4dfbc176f0dd02c08005d3214bc81469bc57)
    #2 0x7ff5245d5e39 in g_strdup (/lib64/libglib-2.0.so.0+0x60e39) (BuildId: 2acd4dfbc176f0dd02c08005d3214bc81469bc57)
    #3 0x7bf50fce0109 in g_strdup_inline /usr/include/glib-2.0/glib/gstrfuncs.h:321:10
    #4 0x7bf50fce0109 in Mate_lex /home/johnthacker/wireshark/plugins/epan/mate/mate_parser.l:315:1
    #5 0x7bf50fcea432 in mate_load_config /home/johnthacker/wireshark/plugins/epan/mate/mate_parser.l:376:3
    #6 0x7bf50fcb4847 in mate_make_config /home/johnthacker/wireshark/plugins/epan/mate/mate_setup.c:702:7
```
